title: Move user profiles to new PostgreSQL schema
description: Run migration script scripts/migrate_profiles.sh before deploying. Downtime approx 10 minutes. Old table 'profiles_v1' is dropped after 30 days.

title: Add bulk user import
description: Admins can upload a CSV of up to 5000 users. Invalid rows are reported in a downloadable error file.

title: Search results slow for accounts with over 100k records
description: Queries can take 8-10s on very large accounts. Workaround: use date filters. Fix planned next release.

title: Fix timezone offset on scheduled reports
description: Reports scheduled for 09:00 in IST were sent at 03:30 UTC+0 display. Now stored with explicit timezone.

title: Rotate leaked staging API key and add secret scanning
description: Key rotated; pre-commit secret scanning enabled in all repos. No production impact.

title: Upgrade Node.js runtime from 16 to 20
description: CI and containers updated. No user-facing change.

title: Dashboard loads faster
description: Lazy-load charts below the fold; median load time 3.1s -> 1.4s.
